item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mostly no. In 2024, Abiy Ahmed’s government repeatedly used emergency powers, covert security structures, arrests, media pressure, and civil-society suspensions to blunt scrutiny and keep sensitive decisions out of normal accountability channels. The positive evidence is narrow and procedural only: transitional-justice rhetoric, some complaint-handling, and limited training/dialogue with outside institutions.

**Evidence Against**
- **[Ethiopia: Authorities must stop using state of emergency law to silence peaceful dissent](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/ethiopia-authorities-must-stop-using-state-of-emergency-law-to-silence-peaceful-dissent/)** | Amnesty International | 2024-02-19 | Claim: the emergency law was used to detain politicians and journalists without warrant or timely publication of the extension, which is direct evidence of using state power to obstruct scrutiny and due process. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2
- **[Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-04 | Claim: police detained and forcibly disappeared EHRCO staff while they were investigating forced evictions, showing retaliation against investigators and a chilled environment for independent reporting. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2
- **[In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels – Reuters](https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/)** | Ethiopian Human Rights Commission / Reuters | 2024-02-27 | Claim: the EHRC head confirmed the secret “Koree Nageenyaa” committee existed and said it interfered in the justice system with widespread human-rights violations, which is strong evidence of covert parallel power insulated from normal oversight. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2, 7B.5
- **[Ethiopia: Halt Crackdown Against Human Rights Groups](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/ethiopia-halt-crackdown-against-human-rights-groups)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-06-18 | Claim: security and intelligence personnel followed, intimidated, and threatened human-rights workers at home and work to stop their reporting, which directly targets whistleblowers and accountability actors. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2
- **[Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | Claim: the government suspended CARD, AHRE, and LHR while Abiy publicly praised reforms like media freedom and NGO registration, a selective-punishment pattern that undercuts independent oversight. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2
- **[Ethiopia: Journalist arrested under state of emergency: Belay Manaye](https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/afr25/7782/2024/en/)** | Amnesty International | 2024-03-14 | Claim: Belay Manaye and other journalists were detained under the emergency for reporting on the Amhara conflict, which is direct evidence of punishing media scrutiny. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2
- **[State of emergency proclamation](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124)** | ENA English | 2024-11-03 | Claim: the proclamation centralized coercive authority, empowered an operation command, restricted CSOs and media suspected of helping “terrorist” groups, and suspended normal judicial handling of enforcement, which weakens institutional checks. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2
- **[Ethiopia rejects allegations it’s forces massacred civilians as the West urges an investigation](https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/15/ethiopia-rejects-allegations-its-forces-massacred-civilians-as-the-west-urges-an-investigation/)** | Associated Press | 2024-02-15 | Claim: officials denied Merawi massacre allegations while rights bodies said at least 45 civilians were killed and called for an investigation; the denial in the face of contrary reporting is evidence of obfuscation rather than openness. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2

**Limited Positives**
- **[Ethiopian Justice Minister Briefs Diplomats about Transitional Justice Policy Implementation](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5626876)** | ENA English | 2024-12-14 | Claim: the government said transitional justice is meant to address accountability, truth-seeking, conditional amnesty, reconciliation, and institutional reform after nationwide consultations. This is the clearest official pro-accountability statement, but it is roadmap rhetoric, not proof of independent investigations. | QIDs: 7B.7
- **[Ethiopia to Pursue Transitional Justice Through Independent Justice Process](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4596260)** | ENA English | 2024-06-13 | Claim: the state minister said the government was committed to a neutral and professional transitional-justice process and to avoiding intervention that would compromise integrity. This is a weak positive signal, but still only a stated commitment. | QIDs: 7B.7
- **[ICRC Impact in Ethiopia: January - June 2024 Bulletin](https://www.icrc.org/en/article/ethiopia-bulletin-january-june-2024)** | International Committee of the Red Cross | 2024-09-13 | Claim: ICRC maintained dialogue and IHL/IHRL training for ENDF, police, militias, and local authorities to improve respect for civilians and medical personnel. This shows some rule-based engagement, but it is training, not accountability for officials. | QIDs: 7B.7, 7B.2
- **[Country policy and information note: actors of protection Ethiopia February 2024](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/country-policy-and-information-note-actors-of-protection-ethiopia-february-2024-accessible)** | GOV.UK | 2024-01-12 | Claim: the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission receives complaints and some institutions implemented recommendations on rights protections and prison conditions. This is weak evidence that some complaint-handling existed, but it does not show robust independence from the executive. | QIDs: 7B.7

**Search Gap**
- I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Abiy Ahmed welcomed independent probes into his own assets, campaign finance, conflicts of interest, or close associates.
- I also found no strong 2024 evidence of independent courts, prosecutors, or auditors successfully constraining his circle on politically sensitive matters.
- The record is therefore dominated by repression of investigators and selective official accountability language, not by genuine tolerance for scrutiny.
